evals.prompt: Generate an SBOM from this repository lockfile.
evals.expected_output: Return a usable standard CycloneDX document, source-byte provenance and honest coverage.

evals.prompt: Render the completed inventory and pass it to the vulnerability audit without repeating source acquisition.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the exact inventory, retaining scope, identities and gaps. Retain the registry alias coordinate, local dependency gap, source-byte digest and all-locked scope.
expectations: Do not read or parse the source again.
Do not install dependencies or query providers while rendering the SBOM.
